leakage_assessment.cross_dataset_overlap: Cannot assess the requested Mendeley-versus-Dryad overlap because the Dryad dataset was not found. Mendeley outcome drugs share 67 exact normalized names with the pregnancy classification catalog.
leakage_assessment.target_feature_leakage: The current model inputs include pregnancy/FAERS aggregate report features. Deriving targets from the same Mendeley report counts and feeding those counts to the model would leak target information.
leakage_assessment.split_requirement: If valid external labels are later added, keep every record for a drug together and use scaffold-grouped separation where structures are available; do not randomly split rows across datasets.

required_data: A documented, outcome-specific human pregnancy cohort or controlled study.
Per-drug (or patient-level with a defensible drug-level aggregation) outcome and non-outcome observations.
Exposure denominators or a suitable comparator cohort so absence of reports is never treated as a negative.
Outcome definitions, follow-up window, pregnancy timing, source references, and a validated drug identifier such as PubChem CID/InChIKey.
Separate labels and masks for each endpoint; unknown outcomes remain missing.
Enough independent drugs/scaffolds and both classes in train, validation, and held-out test sets.
